derivation: or נַהֲלֹל; the same as H5097 (נַהֲלֹל);
def: Nahalal or Nahalol, a place in Palestine

occurrences.text: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Beth–lehem: twelve cities with their villages.
Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.
Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.
